name: HEALTHBANE Campaign Mapping
description: Two-tier ATT&CK mapping for the HEALTHBANE campaign (Observed vs Inferred).

techniques.comment: INFERRED: Delivery mechanism inferred for initial compromise of target infrastructure.
OBSERVED: PowerShell scripts executed to stage payloads and manage runtime.
OBSERVED: Native cmd.exe invocations utilized to chain utility commands.
OBSERVED: Initial execution requires user interaction with dropped attachments.
OBSERVED: Scripts attempt to terminate or disable endpoint security agents.
OBSERVED: Cleanup commands executed to wipe staging directories post-execution.
INFERRED: Code strings and script blocks heavily obfuscated to bypass static analysis.
INFERRED: Commands executed to gather basic OS version and architecture details.
INFERRED: Anticipated lateral movement path using compromised administrative credentials.
INFERRED: Targeted interest in internal medical records and communications.
OBSERVED: Beaconing and data exfiltration conducted over standard HTTPS.
OBSERVED: Stolen archives transferred directly back to adversary infrastructure.
